registration.method: One full-cell transform for both harvest states. States share exactly the same primary, fruit layer and alpha; no geometry or anchor changes.

palette.detail: actual native DetailColor: R when ripe, K when unripe
palette.neutral_preview: Equal RGB only; red extraction aid removed from both saved layers.

appearance: Sparse asymmetric fruit tree with ashen neutral bark texture and six source-inspired fruit marks. Native primary g tint is retained even on described ashen wood; no unsupported third fixed bark color.
state_owner: Native Harvestable owns ripeness, yield1, regeneration and tint. RipeTiles/UnripeTiles absent for this source. No fruit disappears or moves as an invented harvest effect.
native_behavior: Source visibility/occlusion, plant/hanging support and native harvest interaction remain unchanged; native binding/tint acceptance pending.
